Provenance offset index set once by generateOffsetIndex.
Block number recorded when the collection reached MAX_MINTED or via retryOffsetIndexBlock.
Sale state: 0 closed, 1 whitelist, 2 public.
Mapping address => whiteListStruct storing per-wallet purchase amount and existence flag.
Running count of whitelisted members, capped by WHITELIST_MAXMEMBERS.
Base token URI returned by _baseURI, owner controlled.
Provenance hash of the original image ordering, owner controlled.
Initializes ERC721 metadata, sets base URI via setBaseURI and mints the giveaway tokens.
onlyOwner setter for PROVENANCE, protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner setter for BaseURI, protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
Internal view override returning BaseURI for tokenURI computation.
onlyOwner function minting 10 giveaway tokens to msg.sender when totalSupply() is zero.
onlyOwner batch insertion of addresses into WHITELIST with a hard member cap.
View helper that requires the caller to be whitelisted and under the whitelist purchase limit.
onlyOwner state transition of saleSTATE, restricted to values below 3.
Public payable mint entry point branching on saleSTATE for whitelist or public pricing and limits.
Private mint helper: increments tokenCounter, calls _safeMint and records offSetIndexBlock at max supply.
onlyOwner function minting remaining tokens to msg.sender while the sale is closed.

onlyOwner function that resets offSetIndexBlock to the current block while the sale is closed.
onlyOwner function splitting the contract balance 25/25/25/25 across four hardcoded addresses.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, wallet and payer.
Outbound ETH transfers via payable(...).transfer to a fixed set of addresses.
External receiver callback triggered by _safeMint through _checkOnERC721Received, handing control to the recipient contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the recipient of the ten giveaway mints in mintGiveaway.
msg.sender (_msgSender) becomes the minter wallet and payer in mintToken.
The caller derived wallet is forwarded to createToken as the mint recipient.
mintToken calls checkWhiteList when saleSTATE equals 1 before accepting payment.
mintToken loops calling createToken, which mints via _safeMint and yields control to the recipient before the loop finishes.
saleSTATE is read by mintToken to decide whether minting is open and which price branch applies.
mintToken reads and mutates WHITELIST[wallet].amountPurchased to enforce the whitelist allocation.
The caller supplied _amount is compared against totalSupply, MAX_MINTED, PURCHASE_LIMIT and the whitelist limit.
createToken increments tokenCounter and reads tokenCounter.current() as the new token id.
createToken -> _safeMint -> _checkOnERC721Received invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, enabling reentrant calls.
mintGiveaway calls _safeMint directly, invoking the receiver callback on a contract recipient.
createToken writes offSetIndexBlock when totalSupply reaches MAX_MINTED.
withdrawETH performs four outbound ETH transfers to the hardcoded payout addresses.
The cached balance is multiplied by 25 and divided by 100 with SafeMath to derive the payout amount.
generateOffsetIndex consumes blockhash(offSetIndexBlock - 1) as a randomness source when the derived offset is zero.
generateOffsetIndex reads offSetIndexBlock to derive and validate the offset.
generateOffsetIndex writes the computed offset into offSetIndex.
retryOffsetIndexBlock lets the owner overwrite offSetIndexBlock while it is still zero.
addToWhiteList increments WHITELIST_MEMBERCOUNT for every newly added address.
addToWhiteList sets WHITELIST[address].exists for each address in the batch.
checkWhiteList reads WHITELIST[_address].exists and amountPurchased to gate whitelist purchases.
updateSaleState writes saleSTATE under the onlyOwner restriction.
setProvenance writes PROVENANCE and is restricted to the owner.
setBaseURI writes BaseURI and is restricted to the owner.
_baseURI returns the stored BaseURI for tokenURI composition.
mintUnsoldTokens loops calling createToken for the owner.
mintUnsoldTokens requires saleSTATE to be 0 before the owner can mint unsold tokens.
The owner supplied _amount is added to totalSupply and compared with MAX_MINTED before looping.
The constructor calls setBaseURI with the initial URI value.
The constructor calls mintGiveaway to mint the ten giveaway tokens.
The constructor parameter _value is forwarded into setBaseURI as the initial base URI.
mintGiveaway mints the giveaway tokens to msg.sender.
mintToken derives the local wallet variable from _msgSender().

normalization_plan.reason: The provenance hash parameter exists only to be stored by setProvenance and carries no independent security role.
The URI parameter is a passive argument consumed only by the owner-only setBaseURI setter.
The address batch is iterated inline inside addToWhiteList and has no standalone semantics.
The queried address is only used as a WHITELIST lookup key inside the view function.
The new state value is validated and written to saleSTATE by the owner-only setter.
The requested mint amount is fully consumed by the price and limit arithmetic inside mintToken.
The local wallet alias is just _msgSender() and is used only within mintToken for pricing and whitelist accounting.
The recipient argument is passed straight into _safeMint by the private createToken helper.
The amount is used only for the supply check and the minting loop in mintUnsoldTokens.
The computed offset is an intermediate result that immediately becomes offSetIndex and depends on the blockhash randomness operation.
The constructor argument is immediately delegated to setBaseURI and has no independent behavior.
The cached balance is a transient value used only for the payout arithmetic and transfers in withdrawETH.
